name: Algomon (Ultimate)

signature_move.name: Distortion Line
signature_move.description: Fires beams from the eyes on its limbs that are powerful and destructive enough to distort dimensions.

description: A gigantic Ultimate Digimon that evolved from the Perfect-level Algomon , and also amplified its close-combat abilities. Its Special Moves are countless beams fired from its mouth ( Terabyte Disaster ), and beams destructive enough to completely distort even dimensions, fired from the eyes on its limbs ( Distortion Line ). In addition, its " Brute Force ", which mows down the enemy with its massive body, is also exceptionally destructive.
